sourceFacts.fact: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase generates superoxide, supporting antimicrobial oxidant production.
CGD disrupts NADPH oxidase function and impairs killing of certain bacteria and fungi; this illustration isolates the oxidative killing step, not all antimicrobial pathways.

forbiddenAnatomy: Organs, tissue layers, anatomical cutaways, histology, diagnostic scans, clinical photos

checks: No phagocyte membranes, organelles or histology invented.
Capture is present in both rows; the CGD break occurs at oxidative burst.
No claim that every antimicrobial mechanism is absent.
